Description:
  Build system for Exanite.Engine. Primarily used to build and package projects.

Usage:
  Exanite.Engine.BuildSystem.Cli [command] [options]

Options:
  --detached      Runs the command in a detached process.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information.
  --version       Show version information.

Commands:
  package                  Packages the specified project for shipping.
  generate-content-info    [MSBuild] Generates the different content info files for a project.
  generate-resource-class  [MSBuild] Generates the resource class for a project.
  process-engine-project   [MSBuild] Runs all targets relevant to building an Exanite.Engine project. [Depends on: generate-content-info, generate-resource-class]

Description:
  Packages the specified project for shipping.

Usage:
  Exanite.Engine.BuildSystem.Cli package [options]

Options:
  --output <output>                The folder to output the packaged project to. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-exanit-39095a1d-5b32d1f1/outputs]
  --project <project>              The path to the project to be packaged.
  --configuration <Debug|Release>  The MSBuild build configuration to use. Either 'Debug' or 'Release'. [default: Release]
  --advanced-output                Should the package output format be in the advanced, non-simplified format?
                                   This increases the amount of DLLs and files in the packaged zip, but can make things like modding easier.
                                   Specifically, this disables C#'s single file output option and enables debug symbols.
  --all-platforms                  Should the project be packaged for all available platforms?
  --enable-profiling               Should profiling be enabled by default? Profiling is disabled by default to avoid creating a profiling server and to improve performance.
  --no-append-version-to-name      Don't append the version to the output folder and zip names. This can be useful for scripts that expect a certain output name.
  --detached                       Runs the command in a detached process.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information.
